title: Recurring dream of driving and visiting stores
content: So I’ve had dreams like this for years now. This setting is usually a building I’m going into or out of. There’s a parking lot of course and I’m desperate to find my car. It’s usually not the one I’m currently driving in my waking life. Sometimes I travel on these wide highways not even in a vehicle. Just traveling on water and my feet/back? If that makes sense lol. I longboard so usually that is a recurring mode of transport as well. When I get to the stores it is often for xmas (I’m not a huge fan) sometimes it’s groceries. I encounter someone from my past, usually a negative encounter. Then my dream often turns into either stairs, the auditorium, elevators, or a lunch line lol. It feels like we are being herded through a line of some kind? Honestly though lately these have been hyper realistic. The conflicts have been unsettling at times but I think this is due to personal history with a specific person in my life.
